description: Returns server details, tool counts, directory-specific results, individual checks, and a full report link after connecting to a public remote MCP server and reading its tool list without calling tools. Use it when someone asks whether an MCP server meets ChatGPT or Claude directory requirements; for scanning a regular webpage's AI readiness, use scan_webpage_ai_readiness instead. Pass url as the public MCP server address to check its connection, sign-in, domain, and tool rules.

url.description: Address of the public remote MCP server to check, such as https://mcp.example.com/mcp.

name: check_mcp_server_directory_rules
title: Check MCP server directory rules
